full_text:
Article 4 (Support by Computerized Information Processing Organization)
The Registry Information Central Management Office of the Office of Court Administration shall, through a computerized information processing organization, support preservation and management of housing lease contracts and digitized documents bearing fixed dates, efficient use of fixed-date information, and other processing of affairs related to fixed dates.
